In lieu of the above listed assistance, the owner-occupant may elect to utilize the replacement housing payment to rent or purchase another dwelling of his own choosing outside of the project area.
5.8 Tenant-Occupants
It shall be the City's policy to financially assist the tenant-occupants of houses requiring demolition to find suitable standard replacement housing.
Assistance may include:
a. Funds up to $4,000 for the purpose of providing replacement rental housing or the down payment for the purchase of comparable, standard replacement housing.
b. Referral to the Santa Clara County Housing Authority for Section 8 Housing Assistance for low income households.
c. Preparation of a rent stabilization agreement for absentee owners to limit the amount of rent increase for the tenant to not more than the monthly payment required under the terms of the rehabilitation loan.
